header: GET /developers and /developers/<file>: the developer reference (everything under developer-docs/, built by scripts/docs/build-api-docs.mjs), shown only to a signed-in user. The reference lists every route, table and switch of the application and the way each is guarded, so I do not leave it in /public for anyone on the internet: the login session decides (src/lib/apiAuth.ts), and the files are read from the server's own folder, never from a path the browser can choose (the path is checked below). DEV_DOCS_ACCESS=off in the environment switches it off altogether (404). The page loads its own files by relative address, so /developers goes to /developers/index.html first.
